subject.title: [Bug]: After reinstalling (v2026.5.20), agents only provide generic replies, completely ignoring workspace files content and skills

question: Should this issue continue waiting for failing-turn diagnostics, or should maintainers sponsor a live Web UI/Ollama reproduction based on the existing screenshots and second-user comment?
rationale: The current source and latest release still expose the expected context, skills, tools, and diagnostics paths, while the only concrete reproduction attempt did not reproduce the missing injection; deciding whether to spend maintainer proof effort is a human prioritization choice.

options.title: Keep Needs-Info Path
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for the exact failing-turn diagnostics before queueing any repair.

options.title: Sponsor Live Repro
options.body: A maintainer can run a fresh Web UI/Ollama scenario with a controlled workspace and compare prompt diagnostics against the reported screenshots.

options.title: Consolidate If AgentDir Matches
options.body: If the reporter confirms the files were actually under agentDir rather than workspace, route the bootstrap portion to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/29387 while keeping Ollama/browser-tool symptoms separate.

recommendation.title: Keep Needs-Info Path
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for the exact failing-turn diagnostics before queueing any repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has recent merged history on bootstrap routing and reset/session prompt behavior, which is the first layer to rule out before provider/tool diagnosis.
